verdict.rationale: Stripe Tax exposes API endpoints for registrations (Tax Registrations API), nexus/monitoring insights, tax calculations, and reports, and Stripe more broadly documents an official MCP server, which together could let an agent read and act on tax posture. However none of the evidence shows the MCP surface exposing Tax-specific endpoints (nexus, registrations, liability, filings) or scoped/restricted API-key credentials tailored to tax data. missing for 10: tax-specific MCP tool/endpoint documentation, evidence of scoped/restricted credentials for tax data, end-to-end agent action example (e.g., auto-filing via API).
